title: HDFC Diners Club Black credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: An ultra-premium lifestyle card from the Diners Club range offering unlimited lounge access, concierge, milestone benefits, and luxury privileges worldwide.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

benefitRows.name: Amazon Prime
benefitRows.howToAvail: Spend 1.5 lakhs within the first 90 days or upon first year fee realization on your HDFC Bank Diners Club Black Credit Card.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: HDFC Bank Diners Club Black Credit Card holders can select any 2 benefits from cult.fit Live 1-month membership, BookMyShow, TataCLiQ, or Ola cabs vouchers worth ₹500 every month on spends of ₹80,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Go to BookMyShow and select movies/events to be booked.|On payment page, search for the relevent offer, add card details and click on 'Apply Offer'.|Offer will be applied and the payment amount adjusted accordingly.
